acceptance: Each listed benchmark declares a duckdb source dialect and its queries go through translate_sql_query on every platform; a test pins this for all benchmarks (no benchmark bypasses translation without an allowlisted reason).
Corpus diff over all platforms lists every changed query; each change is explained.

Executed comparison on DuckDB, SQLite, DataFusion and PostgreSQL (and ClickHouse via CI) shows equal results to the pre-change SQL for every changed query, or each difference is a reviewed correctness fix.
Query docs for these benchmarks render translated SQL with pretty output; regenerated page list in the PR.
make sql-execution-gate, compat-docs-check, typecheck, comment-policy-check and the retirement check pass; affected published bundles listed in the PR body.
description:
Found by the NULL-ordering audit (fork #67; history://NullsAudit-2). Several benchmarks hand their SQL to engines without translation, so NULL placement and other dialect semantics follow each engine's default: TSBS and DataVault on cloud dialects, NYCTaxi, FlightData, VectorSearch, the Read/Write/Metadata primitives, and the hand-written TPC-DI and CoffeeShop variants. No NULL sort keys exist in the checked data, so there is no impact today. OWNER DECISION 2026-10-25: declare duckdb as their source dialect so they are translated like every other benchmark. Second owner decision: query docs for these benchmarks then render translate_sql_query(pretty) output per platform (exactly what runs); until then #3469 shows them verbatim.
DECISION GATES: (G1) any benchmark whose hand-written per-platform variant exists because translation could not express it: keep the variant and record why, or replace it only if translation reproduces it exactly (executed evidence); stop and ask if neither. (G2) any changed query whose executed result changes on a local engine: stop and ask before landing.
GUARDRAILS: benchmark definitions (query intent, parameters) unchanged; hand-written variants are benchmark data and stay unless G1 allows; no cloud spend; published bundles untouched except known_defects flags per policy when recorded rows were wrong.
